scrapeIssue.missing_privilege: The Shopmon integration is missing permissions: {privileges}. Grant them in the Shopware Administration under Settings → System → Integrations.
scrapeIssue.invalid_credentials: The shop rejected the integration credentials. Check the access key ID and secret and that the integration is active.
scrapeIssue.forbidden: The shop refused API access (403). Check firewall or web-server rules (for example a WAF or IP allowlist) blocking the Shopmon integration.
scrapeIssue.not_found: The Shopware API was not found at the configured shop URL (404). Check the URL, including any subdirectory.
scrapeIssue.redirect: The shop redirects API requests. Use the canonical HTTPS shop URL so requests are not redirected.
scrapeIssue.timeout: The shop did not respond in time. Check the shop's availability and server load.
scrapeIssue.tls: The shop's TLS certificate could not be verified. Check its hostname, certificate chain and expiry.
scrapeIssue.unreachable: The shop could not be reached over the network. Check the URL, DNS and firewall.
scrapeIssue.shop_error: The shop returned a server error. Check the shop's error log for details.
scrapeIssue.invalid_response: The shop returned an unexpected response. Check for a maintenance page or a firewall in front of the API.
scrapeIssue.unknown: Updating failed for an unknown reason. Check the shop URL and the integration.
scrapeIssue.plugins.missing_privilege: Extensions could not be read: the integration is missing permissions: {privileges}. Shopmon cannot report extension updates or security issues until this is fixed.
scrapeIssue.apps.missing_privilege: Apps could not be read: the integration is missing permissions: {privileges}.
scrapeIssue.scheduled_tasks.missing_priv: Scheduled tasks could not be read: the integration is missing permissions: {privileges}. Shopmon cannot warn about overdue tasks until this is fixed.
scrapeIssue.queue.missing_privilege: Message-queue statistics could not be read: the integration is missing permissions: {privileges}.
scrapeIssue.cache_info.missing_privilege: Cache and system information could not be read: the integration is missing permissions: {privileges}.
scrapeIssue.frosh_tools.missing_privileg: FroshTools checks could not be read: the integration is missing permissions: {privileges}. Health and performance checks are missing until this is fixed.
scrapeIssue.sbom.missing_privilege: The Composer package list could not be read: the integration is missing permissions: {privileges}. Security advisories cannot be matched per package until this is fixed.
